title: FieldCell document (0.6)
description: Authoring form for a FieldCell cell or cell group. Validate this shape after JSON-LD compaction with https://use.fieldcell.org/context.jsonld. Dimension keys live in coordinates. A series packs many observations that share every coordinate except one: that coordinate's value is an ordered array, and the cell value is an ordered array of the same length. See SCHEMA.md for alignment rules, nexting, and the 0.5.2 migration.

context.description: The FieldCell context. An array may include extension contexts; one entry must be the FieldCell context URL.

valueLiteral.description: A measurement token. Null keeps a series position and does not mean zero. Strings are not coerced to numbers.

nodeRef.description: A reference to another cell or entity. Inside coordinates use @id. Top-level JSON-LD compaction aliases @id to id.

coordinateValue.description: A scalar position, a reference to another cell, or the ordered keys of the single series axis.

@type.description: Token for schema:PropertyValue. Inside the JSON value blob this string is not expanded by the context.

propertyID.description: Identifier of the measured property. Absolute IRIs are recommended.

propertyValue.description: Qualified payload. When value is an array, unit and scale apply to every position. A change of unit is a different cell. Unknown fields are retained.

measurement.description: Scalar payload, series payload, or qualified PropertyValue. Identity cells omit this property.

arrayMeasurement.description: Measurement whose positions line up with the series axis.

id.description: Global identifier of this cell. A label, array index, or local key does not identify the cell.

type.description: JSON-LD type. Cell and CellGroup are the common values. Other types are allowed.

coordinates.description: Open map of dimension name to position. Keys should be FieldCell context terms (timeClaimedTrue, criterion, alternative, role) or absolute IRIs. At most one value may be an array; that dimension is the series axis. Author, creation time, and membership are cell fields, not required members of each coordinate.

seriesAxis.description: Coordinates key whose array value is the packed dimension. Optional when exactly one coordinate is an array. The key is matched literally, not as an expanded IRI.

author.description: Attribution for this fragment. A name, an IRI, or a node reference. Distinct from a decision dimension unless a publisher also places author in coordinates.

dateCreated.description: When this cell artifact was created. ISO 8601 date-time is recommended. This is not the time the claim is about.

validFrom.description: When this record is in effect.

validThrough.description: When this record stops being in effect.

isPartOf.description: Attachment or membership. Targets may be a group, a parent criterion, or another cell. An array records more than one parent. The target's role distinguishes group membership from criterion nesting.

externalReference.description: External resource associated with this cell.

label.description: Human-readable name. Renaming a label does not mint a new id.

cells.description: Ordered publication of member cells or references to them. Embed a cell to publish it inline. Use a node reference after flattening. Membership is also stated by each member's isPartOf. List order is not a ranking.

oneOf.description: A single cell or a nested cell group.
Flattened JSON-LD graph produced by an RDF round trip. Member bodies are graph nodes; list entries may be references.
